user.title: Connect ČEZ PND
user.description: The existing PND app must use native mode. Your PND sign-in stays in that app.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect ČEZ PND
reauth_confirm.description: If ČEZ rejected sign-in, update the credentials in the PND app first. You can update the connection token here.

error.cannot_connect: The PND app is unavailable or its legacy importer is still active.
error.invalid_auth: The PND app or ČEZ rejected authentication.
error.invalid_configuration: Check the statistic identifier and history date.

abort.already_configured: This supply point is already configured.

init.title: History and electricity prices
init.description: Prices include VAT. Enable Save price change to add a price period. To update past costs, then run Recalculate historical costs. The end date is exclusive.

data.correction_days: Recent days to check for corrections
data.replace_source: Replace an existing source for this supply point (none = keep all)

authentication.title: ČEZ PND – Sign-in needs attention
authentication.description: Check the credentials in the PND app and the integration connection token. Detail: {detail}.

synchronization.title: ČEZ PND – Synchronization is retrying
synchronization.description: PND is unavailable or its export format changed. The integration retries automatically with increasing delay. Detail: {detail}.

missing_measurements.title: ČEZ PND – Incomplete measured history
missing_measurements.description: Some days have incomplete measurements. Missing values are never filled with zero. These days will be checked again. Days: {detail}.

tariff_data.title: ČEZ PND – Unverified tariff readings
tariff_data.description: Daily tariff readings are missing or disagree with the consumption profile. No hourly tariff split is estimated. Days: {detail}.

price_data.title: ČEZ PND – Historical prices are missing
price_data.description: Part of the history has no confirmed price period. Add the applicable prices in the integration settings and recalculate historical costs. Days: {detail}.

init.title: Review ČEZ PND settings
init.description: Continue to the integration settings. Replace an existing energy source only if it measures the same supply point. After changing historical prices, run Recalculate historical costs.

energy_configuration.title: ČEZ PND – Energy configuration needs attention
energy_configuration.description: Automatic Energy setup stopped because of a source conflict or validation error. Existing unrelated sources are preserved. Detail: {detail}.

init.title: Review ČEZ PND settings
